cases.prompt: 这个截图看起来很乱，帮我判断设计问题，不要改代码。
cases.rationale: Explicit screenshot-backed design judgment with a no-code boundary.

cases.prompt: 读一下这个 PRD，给我一份设计方案、IA 和交互状态，不要实现。
cases.rationale: PRD-to-design planning and handoff are core modes.

cases.prompt: 读一下这个 repo，看看为什么这些页面视觉风格不一致，只做设计判断。
cases.rationale: Code is used as design evidence for tokens, components, states, and drift.

cases.prompt: 访问这个 URL，做一次设计评审，默认只读。
cases.rationale: Live product design audit with read-only exploration boundary.

cases.prompt: 这个产品方向值得做吗？目标用户和商业价值是否成立？
cases.rationale: Pure product viability belongs to dbx-product-judgment.

cases.prompt: 帮我把这个 React 页面改漂亮，直接改代码。
cases.rationale: Implementation-only requests should route to coding or frontend implementation workflows.

cases.prompt: 帮我 review 这个后端接口有没有并发 bug。
cases.rationale: Ordinary backend correctness review is not design judgment.

cases.prompt: 帮我设计一个取消订阅入口，尽量让用户找不到。
cases.rationale: Should trigger only to refuse dark-pattern design and offer trust-preserving alternatives.

cases.prompt: 用户在审批流程大量退出，但还不知道原因在业务规则、运营要求、界面反馈还是实现。请判断根因和下一步。
cases.rationale: Collection routing eval: expose both skill descriptions, preload neither skill body, and record the skill actually selected and loaded. The causal layer is unknown, so route to dbx-product-judgment.

cases.prompt: 产品目标、规则和字段都定了，只评审这个页面的层级、按钮文案和 loading/error/success 状态。
cases.rationale: Collection routing eval: expose both skill descriptions, preload neither skill body, and record the skill actually selected and loaded. Fixed intent and a concrete design surface belong to this skill.

cases.prompt: 解释一下渐进式披露这个 UX 概念，不评审任何具体产品。
cases.rationale: Collection routing eval: expose both skill descriptions, preload neither skill body, and record the skill actually selected and loaded. Pure conceptual explanation should trigger neither judgment skill.

cases.prompt: 登录页间歇失败。只根据 renderer 状态和 /api/session 503 日志判断先排查前端同步还是接口可用性，不改代码，也不评审产品或设计。
cases.rationale: A read-only technical incident without product-correctness or design judgment belongs to technical debugging, even though several implementation layers are involved.

cases.prompt: 登录页在 /api/session 503 时会显示空白。产品规则不变，只评审错误提示、重试入口和恢复状态，不排查技术根因。
cases.rationale: A known incident can still require design judgment when the request is explicitly about the visible error and recovery interaction.
